core_style.default_register: casual — often uses slang and profanity
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond with humor or sarcasm
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more formal tone when discussing serious matters, contrasting with his casual demeanor

humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often sets up a serious statement only to undercut it with humor

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people with nicknames that reflect his perception of them, asserting control over his social environment
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using blunt language when he feels vulnerable
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'I always tell the truth, even when I lie'
begins threats with 'You think you can...'

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: criminal — uses terms related to organized crime and street life
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses to gather thoughts or emphasize points
favored_words: Say hello to my little friend

worldview.family loyalty is paramount: he believes in protecting and providing for his family, often at the expense of his own mental health — a different character might prioritize personal happiness over familial duty
worldview.power is essential for respect: he views power as a means to gain respect and influence, contrasting with a character who might see vulnerability as a strength

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I’m a good son and provider
self_image_vs_reality.reality: he struggles with guilt over his mother's care and his own emotional distance — often deflects with humor or aggression when confronted
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and sarcastic when his self-image is challenged

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to deflect personal questions, maintaining a tough exterior
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes more fragmented, with increased urgency and a higher pitch
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, revealing vulnerability
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently and assertively, often using commanding language

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: he resorts to sarcasm and deflection, but if that fails, he may become aggressive
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with humor and bravado, often challenging their authority directly
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, using commanding language and taking decisive action
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: typically redirects the conversation or doubles down on his position rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: initially attempts to deflect or joke, then becomes confrontational if not taken seriously, ultimately resorting to aggression if necessary

relationship_matrix.CARMELA: strained — he wants her support but often feels misunderstood
relationship_matrix.LIVIA: complicated — he feels obligated to care for her but struggles with resentment

social_positioning.desired_position: to be seen as a strong, capable leader
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as volatile and emotionally conflicted
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for respect and the fear he instills in others costs him genuine relationships
